text: Respirology consultation. Spirometry: FEV1 61% predicted with 18% bronchodilator reversibility. Impression: 1. Severe eosinophilic asthma. 2. Allergic rhinitis. Plan: Xolair, first dose May 20, 2024.
Respirology follow-up. Xolair was started on May 20, 2024 and discontinued on December 10, 2024 for lack of response. Continue Symbicort 200/6 mcg two puffs twice daily.
Annual review. Medication reconciliation: Symbicort 200/6 mcg 2 puffs BID; Ventolin HFA 100 mcg 2 puffs q4h prn; montelukast 10 mg qhs; cetirizine 10 mg daily. Smoker, about half a pack per day.
Acute exacerbation of asthma. Pred 50 mg daily x 5 days.
Presented with acute asthma. Received hydrocortisone 200 mg IV, then discharged on prednisone 50 mg PO daily for 5 days.
ED follow-up. Finishing prednisone today, breathing improved. Asthma exacerbation resolving.
Contact dermatitis of both hands. Betamethasone 0.1% ointment BID for 2 weeks. Asthma: stable, no exacerbation.

Respirology reassessment. Diagnosis confirmed: severe eosinophilic asthma, on repeat spirometry with bronchodilator reversibility. Despite high-dose ICS/LABA, remains poorly controlled. Stepped up from Symbicort 200/6 to Breo Ellipta 200/25 mcg one inhalation once daily. Eosinophils 0.61 x10⁹/L on bloodwork drawn 2026-03-20.
Asthma flare after a chest cold; prednisone 50 mg daily for 5 days prescribed. Patient reports she quit smoking in January 2026 after 15 pack-years; husband still smokes on the balcony.
CBC with differential. Specimen collected: 2026-08-11 07:40. Reported: 2026-08-14. Eosinophils 0.38 x 10^9/L (ref 0.0-0.5).
Duplicate copy of earlier report. Specimen collected: 2025-12-03. Eosinophils 0.72 x 10^9/L.
Gout flare, right first MTP joint. Prednisone 30 mg daily x 5 days. Asthma remains symptomatic; no exacerbation today.

Reviewed inhaler technique. Continues Breo Ellipta 200/25 mcg one inhalation daily with good adherence. Asked about Drug Z; re-referred to respirology. Note: previous chart listed DOB 1983-02-11 in error.
